messages:
Maya: quick sync — planning to ship the internal release notes + announce for the 'slate sprint' during the 10:30-11:30 PT change window. i'll pin model v2.3.1 for hosted and dedicated. any objections?
Lina: looks good to me. did we finalize the microcopy for the outage blurb?
Ajay: pushed a one-liner for SLA + rollback steps into the snippet below. pls review.
Sam: agree with pinning v2.3.1. also adding a watch rule: alert if 5xx rate >1% for 5m.
Vik: small ask — add fallback note that we can route to quantized-v2.3.1-q if GPU pressure >90%.
Maya: good point, vik. i'll add a line about automatic variant fallback.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02T17:35:00Z (canary on 2 pods). will report status updates here.
Maya: internal announcement snippet (draft) — please comment: 
```
Heads up: Slate Sprint deploy starts 10:35 PT. Primary model: v2.3.1 (pinned). Fallback: v2.3.1-q (quantized) and previous stable v2.3.0.
Impact: brief cache warm-up may cause transient latency increase for a small % of requests. Target p95 < 220ms.
If you see production regressions, run: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --env prod --to v2.3.0 --reason "regression p95"` and notify #eng-oncall.
```
Lina: nits — change "may cause" -> "may briefly cause", and add contact @Sam for oncall.
Ajay: SLA blurb: "This deploy is non-disruptive; in case of sustained regressions we'll rollback to v2.3.0. Expected downtime: none." approved.
Sam: added watch: `errors.5xx_rate > 0.01 for 5m` and pager rule to @eng-oncall. will be monitoring.
DeployBot: canary status: 2/2 checks passed, no exceptions. proceeding to full rollout.
Maya: thanks — final edit pushed to the snippet above (changed wording, added contacts). i'm going to post the internal announce at T-15.
Vik: approved from infra side. confirmed quantized variant available and routing policy in place.
DeployBot: rollout completed at 2026-04-02T17:40:21Z, no errors recorded.
Sam: monitoring metrics now, no regressions; latency stable. will keep an eye for 30m.
Maya: perfect — announcing now. if anything pops up, escalate to oncall. closing thread. :tada:
